# 2 Clement — Chapter 5 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 5
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Brothers, we are only passing through this world. Let us leave behind our attachment to it, do what our caller asks of us, and not be afraid to die.
2. The Lord himself said: "You will be like lambs among wolves."
3. Peter asked him: "But what happens when wolves tear lambs apart?"
4. Jesus answered: "Once the lambs are dead, they have nothing to fear from wolves. So do not be afraid of those who can kill your body and nothing more. Fear the one who, after your death, has power over your soul and body — who can throw them into the fire of Gehenna."
5. Brothers, understand this: our stay in this body in this world is brief and fleeting. But Christ's promise is magnificent — rest in the coming kingdom, and eternal life.
6. What must we do to receive it? Live in holiness and righteousness. Treat the things of this world as though they belong to someone else, and don't crave them.
7. The moment we start craving those things, we have stepped off the right path.
